cards.name: 短語_一次一次的練習著
cards.scene: On a windy cliff, a mother eagle watches her young eaglet flap its wings against strong wind, trying to fly again and again; small motion lines show many tries.

cards.name: 短語_一遍一遍的朗讀著
cards.scene: A child standing by a window holding an open book, reading aloud again and again; little repeating speech bubbles with simple lines (no letters).

cards.name: 短語_一回一回的嘗試著
cards.scene: A child trying to toss a ring onto a bottle at a game stall, several rings on the ground from earlier tries, the child aiming again with determination.

cards.name: 短語_一天一天的努力著
cards.scene: Three small panels in a row showing the same girl practicing violin at morning, afternoon and evening, with a calendar beside her.

cards.name: 情境_一次一次的練習著
cards.scene: A little boy learning to ride a bicycle in a park; he has fallen, scraped knee with a bandage, and is getting back on the bike again to try one more time; a parent encouraging.

cards.name: 情境_一口一口的品嘗著
cards.scene: A child at a table slowly eating a pudding with a small spoon, taking one small bite at a time, savoring it with closed eyes; mother smiling nearby.

cards.name: 情境_一頁一頁的閱讀著
cards.scene: In a quiet library, a child sitting on a cushion turning the pages of a storybook one by one, totally absorbed.

cards.name: 情境_一筆一筆的書寫著
cards.scene: Calligraphy class: a child carefully writing with a Chinese ink brush on red-lined paper, one careful stroke at a time; ink stone beside (no readable characters).

cards.name: 短語_最酷熱的沙漠
cards.scene: A vast hot desert under a blazing sun, heat waves rising from the sand, a lonely camel, a cactus; everything looks extremely hot.

cards.name: 短語_最巨大的生物
cards.scene: A huge blue whale swimming in the ocean next to a tiny boat with a child waving, showing how enormous the whale is.

cards.name: 短語_最閃亮的星星
cards.scene: A night sky full of stars where one star shines much brighter than all others, a child pointing at it from a rooftop.

cards.name: 短語_最有趣的故事
cards.scene: A grandpa telling a story to a group of children who are laughing so hard they hold their bellies; little imaginary funny animals floating above.

cards.name: 情境_最高大的樹
cards.scene: A school playground with one enormous tree beside the classroom building; the tree is taller than the building; children look small beneath it.

cards.name: 情境_最好吃的蛋糕
cards.scene: A birthday party: a mother serves a homemade strawberry cream cake, children taking bites with delighted faces, thumbs up.

cards.name: 情境_最熱鬧的夜市
cards.scene: A crowded Taiwanese night market at night: many people, food stalls with steam and lanterns, families laughing; very busy and lively (no readable signs).

cards.name: 情境_最安靜的圖書館
cards.scene: A calm library where several children read silently, one child turning a page very gently with a finger on lips sign gesture from a librarian; peaceful mood.

cards.name: 短語_望著這面小小的蛛網
cards.scene: A child and father leaning close to a desk lamp at night, gazing at a tiny spider web with a tiny spider on it, curious and quiet.

cards.name: 短語_吃著這顆紅紅的蘋果
cards.scene: A child biting into a shiny bright red apple, holding it with both hands.

cards.name: 短語_看著這片藍藍的天空
cards.scene: A child lying on green grass looking up at a clear bright blue sky with a few small white clouds.

cards.name: 短語_抱著一本厚厚的書本
cards.scene: A child hugging a very thick big book against the chest, smiling proudly.

cards.name: 情境_軟軟的小狗
cards.scene: After school, a child at home hugging a fluffy soft little puppy in their arms, cheek against its fur, both look happy.

cards.name: 情境_冰冰的果汁
cards.scene: On a hot summer day, a child drinking a glass of orange juice with ice cubes through a straw; cold water drops on the glass; sun shining.

cards.name: 情境_圓圓的皮球
cards.scene: At recess on the school playground, a child kicking a round colorful ball, mid-kick, classmates nearby.

cards.name: 情境_長長的雨傘
cards.scene: On a rainy day, a child in a raincoat walking to school holding a long umbrella over the head, puddles on the road.
